seo.title: Test Studio — Online Exam, Test & Worksheet Maker (AI + OMR)
seo.description: Online exam, test and worksheet maker for teachers. Crop PDF questions, extract answer keys with AI, scan sheets with built-in OMR (optical reader). Free to start.
seo.keywords: online exam maker, online test maker, exam maker, test maker, online exam, online test, AI exam maker, AI test maker, AI worksheet builder, OMR scanner, optical mark reader, optical reader, PDF question cropper, answer key extraction, worksheet generator, teacher tools

hero.title:
Build your exams
<1>in minutes
hero.subtitle: Crop questions from PDFs, design professional exams in your own style, and scan answer sheets with the OMR module. Hours of work in Word now take minutes.

features.label: Features
features.title: The easiest way to prepare exams

crop.title: Crop Questions from PDFs
crop.desc: Select questions from existing PDFs, crop them with automatic boundary detection, and add them to your question bank.

solutionTest.title: Tests with Solution Space
solutionTest.desc: Test layouts with a solution-writing area below each question. Students write their solutions directly on the exam paper — no extra sheets needed.

fascicle.title: Your Own Topic Booklet
fascicle.desc: Combine topic explanations, sample questions, and solved examples into your own booklet. Publisher-quality typesetting, ready to distribute in minutes.

writtenExam.title: Written Exam Module
writtenExam.desc: Create open-ended, true/false, matching, fill-in-the-blank, and many more question types using the rich text editor.

pptx.title: Automatic PowerPoint Slides
pptx.desc: Prepare a test and a PowerPoint file is generated automatically. Project it in class and walk through questions slide by slide — no extra prep.

omr.title: Optical Mark Reader (OMR)
omr.desc: Create an optical answer sheet with one click, scan student forms with your phone camera, and get results and class report cards instantly.

aiKey.title: AI-Powered Answer Key Extraction
aiKey.desc: Let AI automatically extract the answer key from your PDF. No more typing answers one by one.

layout.title: Flexible Page Layout
layout.desc: Portrait or landscape orientation, column count, margins — customize everything to match your design.

print.title: Print-Ready Output
print.desc: Professional-quality PDF and Word output. High DPI optimized for batch printing.

how.label: How It Works
how.title: Your exam is ready in three steps

step1.title: Crop Questions from PDFs
step1.desc: Drag and drop PDF files. Select questions with your mouse, crop them with automatic boundary detection. You can even extract the answer key with AI.

step2.title: Organize in the Pool
step2.desc: Reorder questions with drag and drop. Sort by category, edit answers, create test groups.

step3.title: Finish on the Layout Desk
step3.desc: Pick test, lecture notes, or written exam; tweak the page layout and template to match your style. Alongside PDF and Word, a <1>PowerPoint presentation is also generated automatically</1>.
